budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each merchant needs two units of its required kind at its own depot. Initially nobody owns the kind they need. Negotiate through visible recipient quotes, physical deposits, conditional cycles or unsecured gifts, then transport the newly owned goods.
task.natural_termination: Every merchant has delivered two required-kind goods. Otherwise truncate at 120 steps. A natural completion on step 120 takes priority. Terminal raw state is absorbing.
task.interaction: Ownership, carrier, commitment, recipient and lock timer belong to each physical good. Whole compatible bilateral or three-party cycles transfer title only after all offers mature. Goods stay on the seller's actual pad after settlement and must be fetched. Withdrawing before settlement prevents the whole dependent cycle; gifts bypass that protection and can be claimed or withheld. Merchants compete for occupied corridor cells and finite time.
task.observation_access: All cargo positions, ownership, carriers, escrow commitments, timers, quotes, depot needs and event flags are public. Every entity visibility mask is true. The static walls and pad/depot geometry are public. No text messages or extra renderer-only policy information exist.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Goods physically deposited into new commitments
Recipients gaining title in completed conditional cycles
Mature commitments withdrawn at the seller's pad
Carried goods released to public ownership
Required-kind cargo consumed at its owner's depot

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
